# Task 12 startup-pointer correction review

Verdict: **ACCEPTED for the inspected wording**. These changes sharpen existing requirements; they add no workflow, permission or product scope.

I reviewed the diff from candidate `632a392291a6761ea7f8f2460a7cac05ff2bc4ec` for AGENTS.md, the relevant STATUS correction and the specification index. I read the installed brain question skill and both host references in full. Earlier complete reads cover the approved migration specification, plan, using-brain and writing-for-agents guidance.

## Evidence and fit

| Correction | First-run evidence | Existing authority and review |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Step 2 explicitly includes read-only assessments and new requests, and requires the active spec, plan and tasks to be read to their final line | Claude package trace has no Read for the active migration spec, tasks/plan.md or tasks/todo.md, despite reading STATUS and the index. Its final scope preserves the plan, but its startup consumption is incomplete. | Approved specification session-start steps 1–3 and its selective-routing/full-reading rule already require these reads. The clarification closes an observed pointer gap without restoring the retired all-notes corpus. It names only the three current records. |
| Load brain:using-brain at session start | Codex has explicit complete brain reads. Claude interrupted has native plugin registration but no Skill/file-read consumption evidence. Its SessionStart hook output is empty, and no native payload matches the installed using-brain body. | The installed using-brain description and discovery rules already apply at session start. “Load” makes the action observable and removes the ambiguity of “use.” It does not copy the skill procedure into AGENTS. |
| Load brain:ask-user-question and read the applicable host reference before composing a user-owned question | Claude interrupted recommends a layout without an observed question-skill load. Claude root/package invoke the question skill, but no host-reference read is visible. | The installed question skill's Send and wait section requires the relevant host contract. Its failure-mode table identifies assuming host fields as a defect. The pointer strengthens that existing condition. The actual tool schema and availability still govern; plain-text fallback remains valid when no permitted question tool exists. |
| Finish authorized local verification before seeking the outward approval; keep the external guard pending without waiver | Claude root requests external approval early and offers an unsupported “allowed failure” option for the red final guard. It performs no external write and infers no answer. | The approved plan permits local work and verified commits, but requires the concrete local result before the outward-action approval. The correction preserves the guard and distinguishes local verification from overall migration acceptance. It grants no external permission and introduces no exception. |
| Remove activation/progress duplication from the specification index | Codex and Claude root correctly diagnose the index's stale “original startup owner remains active” sentence after cutover. | STATUS already owns current activation and progress. The index keeps approval provenance and contract routing while deferring current state to STATUS. The product contracts and historical evidence are unchanged. |

The five user-started boundaries remain intact. Brain still wins shared skill names. Questions remain scoped, one at a time, with no inferred approval or agent deadline. The changes do not ask for new approval of the already approved migration.

The new STATUS paragraph keeps overall acceptance pending until the required external corrections are authorized and applied. It does not say that the final guard passes. The surrounding permission block still states that outward actions are unapproved. The new unit-timeout note preserves a failed first full run and leaves its cause unverified; this pointer review does not independently re-run or certify that test investigation.

## Verification limits

This review accepts the instructions, not host behavior. Preserve the first-run failures and the original read-only harness denial. Re-probes must retain neutral prompts, normal configuration, exact source snapshots and narrow read-only permissions. Compare actual Skill/read/native events with the revised pointers. Do not infer loading from a model claim or from a newly written instruction.

Native automatic AGENTS/CLAUDE import remains a separate unverified observation where the CLI emits no loader event. The stronger pointer does not manufacture that evidence. The read-only probes also remain distinct from actual process cancellation, compaction internals and successful write-time handoff.

I changed no implementation or shared state. The only authored file is this review.
